links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of ChatGPT outputs compared with NASS guidelines
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 mean Flesch score 15.24 (college graduate level); ChatGPT-3.5 8.73 (professional level); NASS guidelines 4.58. Both were more accessible than the guidelines but still very difficult to read.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.0 outputs had a mean Flesch reading score of 15.24, which is very difficult to read, requiring a college graduate education to understand.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, safety, and readability of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 against clinical guidelines for cervical radiculopathy without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
